ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Human Services Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding allocations within the Minnesota Department of Human Services to identify potential corruption and fraud
questions: What are the sources of funding for the Minnesota Department of Human Services?
How are these funds being allocated and utilized?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we may be able to identify patterns of corruption and fraud within the department. This investigation could lead to significant revelations and potential recoveries of misallocated funds.
